#!/usr/bin/env python3

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path("/root/savant-runtime")

NEXUS = (
    ROOT
    / "ontology"
    / "obelisks"
    / "_template"
    / "segue"
    / "gates"
    / "_template"
    / "segue"
    / "innates"
    / "_template"
    / "segue"
    / "exiles"
    / "modus"
    / "segue"
    / "prodigals"
    / "nexus"
)

ADAPTER_PATH = (
    NEXUS
    / "runtime"
    / "legacy_dataset_adapter.py"
)

DEFAULT_OUTPUT_ROOT = (
    ROOT
    / "runtime"
    / "nexus"
    / "imports"
)


def load_adapter():
    if not ADAPTER_PATH.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError(
            "missing nexus adapter: "
            + str(ADAPTER_PATH)
        )

    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "nexus_legacy_dataset_adapter",
        ADAPTER_PATH
    )

    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "unable to load nexus adapter"
        )

    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(
        spec
    )

    sys.modules[spec.name] = module

    spec.loader.exec_module(module)

    return module


adapter_module = load_adapter()


def ensure_inside_runtime(
    path: Path
) -> Path:
    resolved = path.resolve()

    if (
        resolved != ROOT
        and ROOT not in resolved.parents
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "output must remain under "
            "/root/savant-runtime"
        )

    return resolved


def atomic_json_write(
    path: Path,
    payload: dict
) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True
    )

    temp = path.with_suffix(
        path.suffix + ".tmp"
    )

    temp.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            payload,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            sort_keys=True,
            indent=2
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8"
    )

    json.loads(
        temp.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )

    temp.replace(path)


def run_import(
    source: Path,
    output_root: Path
) -> dict:
    adapter = (
        adapter_module.LegacyDatasetAdapter(
            source
        )
    )

    projection = adapter.projection()
    receipt = adapter.receipt()

    import_id = (
        "legacy-"
        + adapter.source_sha256[:16]
    )

    destination = ensure_inside_runtime(
        output_root / import_id
    )

    normalized_path = (
        destination
        / "normalized-dataset.json"
    )

    receipt_path = (
        destination
        / "migration-receipt.json"
    )

    atomic_json_write(
        normalized_path,
        projection
    )

    atomic_json_write(
        receipt_path,
        receipt
    )

    loaded_projection = json.loads(
        normalized_path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )

    loaded_receipt = json.loads(
        receipt_path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )

    if (
        loaded_projection[
            "source"
        ]["data_sha256"]
        != loaded_receipt[
            "source_data_sha256"
        ]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "written projection/receipt source "
            "digest mismatch"
        )

    if not loaded_projection[
        "reconstruction"
    ]["matches_source_data"]:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "written nexus projection is not lossless"
        )

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "authority_effect": "none",
        "mutation_authorized": False,
        "import_id": import_id,
        "source": str(source.resolve()),
        "source_sha256": (
            adapter.source_sha256
        ),
        "data_sha256": (
            adapter.data_sha256
        ),
        "record_count": len(
            adapter.records
        ),
        "section_counts": (
            adapter.section_counts()
        ),
        "normalized_dataset": str(
            normalized_path
        ),
        "migration_receipt": str(
            receipt_path
        ),
        "lossless_reconstruction": True
    }


def selftest() -> dict:
    test_data = {
        "events": [
            {
                "id": "EVT-001",
                "status": "user-reported",
                "title": "reported event"
            },
            {
                "id": "EVT-002",
                "status": "primary government document",
                "title": "documented event"
            }
        ],
        "claims": [
            {
                "id": "CLM-001",
                "status": "disputed"
            }
        ],
        "case_metadata": {
            "case_id": "TEST-001",
            "data_status": "test"
        }
    }

    html = (
        "<!doctype html><html><body><script>"
        "const DATA="
        + json.dumps(
            test_data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            separators=(",", ":")
        )
        + ";</script></body></html>"
    )

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        source = (
            Path(tmp)
            / "legacy.html"
        )

        source.write_text(
            html,
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

        adapter = (
            adapter_module.LegacyDatasetAdapter(
                source
            )
        )

        projection = adapter.projection()

        states = {
            record[
                "external_id"
            ]: record[
                "evidentiary_state_candidate"
            ]
            for record in projection["records"]
            if record["external_id"]
        }

        errors = []

        if adapter.reconstruct() != test_data:
            errors.append(
                "lossless reconstruction failed"
            )

        if states.get(
            "EVT-001"
        ) != "reported":
            errors.append(
                "reported state mapping failed"
            )

        if states.get(
            "EVT-002"
        ) != "corroborated":
            errors.append(
                "corroborated state mapping failed"
            )

        if states.get(
            "CLM-001"
        ) != "disputed":
            errors.append(
                "disputed state mapping failed"
            )

        if projection[
            "authority_effect"
        ] != "none":
            errors.append(
                "adapter acquired authority effect"
            )

        return {
            "ok": not errors,
            "errors": errors,
            "record_count": (
                projection[
                    "record_count"
                ]
            ),
            "section_counts": (
                projection[
                    "section_counts"
                ]
            ),
            "lossless_reconstruction": (
                projection[
                    "reconstruction"
                ][
                    "matches_source_data"
                ]
            ),
            "authority_effect": (
                projection[
                    "authority_effect"
                ]
            )
        }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "losslessly adapt a legacy embedded "
            "nexus DATA dataset into a savant-native "
            "candidate projection"
        )
    )

    parser.add_argument(
        "--source"
    )

    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-root",
        default=str(
            DEFAULT_OUTPUT_ROOT
        )
    )

    parser.add_argument(
        "--selftest",
        action="store_true"
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.selftest:
        result = selftest()

        print(
            json.dumps(
                result,
                indent=2,
                sort_keys=True
            )
        )

        return (
            0
            if result["ok"]
            else 1
        )

    if not args.source:
        parser.error(
            "--source is required unless "
            "--selftest is used"
        )

    result = run_import(
        Path(args.source),
        Path(args.output_root)
    )

    print(
        json.dumps(
            result,
            indent=2,
            sort_keys=True
        )
    )

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence

OWNER = "cataxis"
SCHEMA = "savant://cataxis/spacetime/1.0.0"

EPSILON = 1e-12

DISTANCE_FACTORS_METERS = {
    "m": 1.0,
    "km": 1000.0,
    "cm": 0.01,
    "mm": 0.001,
    "mi": 1609.344,
    "ft": 0.3048,
    "in": 0.0254,
}

DURATION_FACTORS_SECONDS = {
    "s": 1.0,
    "ms": 0.001,
    "min": 60.0,
    "h": 3600.0,
    "day": 86400.0,
}

VELOCITY_FACTORS_MPS = {
    "m/s": 1.0,
    "km/h": 1000.0 / 3600.0,
    "mph": 1609.344 / 3600.0,
    "ft/s": 0.3048,
}


class CataxisError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class UnitError(CataxisError):
    pass


class TemporalError(CataxisError):
    pass


class SpatialError(CataxisError):
    pass


class FeasibilityError(CataxisError):
    pass


def canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        default=str,
    )


def digest(value: Any) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(
        canonical_json(value).encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()


def utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _finite(value: Any, name: str) -> float:
    try:
        number = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise CataxisError(
            f"{name} must be numeric"
        ) from exc

    if not math.isfinite(number):
        raise CataxisError(
            f"{name} must be finite"
        )

    return number


def _nonnegative(value: Any, name: str) -> float:
    number = _finite(value, name)

    if number < 0:
        raise CataxisError(
            f"{name} must be nonnegative"
        )

    return number


def parse_time(value: Any) -> datetime:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        parsed = value
    else:
        text = str(value or "").strip()

        if not text:
            raise TemporalError(
                "timestamp is required"
            )

        if text.endswith("Z"):
            text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"

        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise TemporalError(
                f"invalid timestamp: {value}"
            ) from exc

    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        raise TemporalError(
            "timestamp must include timezone"
        )

    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)


def convert(
    value: Any,
    *,
    from_unit: str,
    to_unit: str,
    dimension: str,
) -> float:
    tables = {
        "distance": DISTANCE_FACTORS_METERS,
        "duration": DURATION_FACTORS_SECONDS,
        "velocity": VELOCITY_FACTORS_MPS,
    }

    table = tables.get(
        str(dimension).strip().lower()
    )

    if table is None:
        raise UnitError(
            f"unsupported dimension: {dimension}"
        )

    source = str(from_unit).strip()
    target = str(to_unit).strip()

    if source not in table:
        raise UnitError(
            f"unsupported {dimension} unit: {source}"
        )

    if target not in table:
        raise UnitError(
            f"unsupported {dimension} unit: {target}"
        )

    number = _finite(value, "value")

    base = number * table[source]

    return base / table[target]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Point3:
    x: float
    y: float
    z: float = 0.0
    unit: str = "m"

    def meters(self) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
        if self.unit not in DISTANCE_FACTORS_METERS:
            raise UnitError(
                f"unsupported distance unit: {self.unit}"
            )

        factor = DISTANCE_FACTORS_METERS[
            self.unit
        ]

        return (
            _finite(self.x, "x") * factor,
            _finite(self.y, "y") * factor,
            _finite(self.z, "z") * factor,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TimeWindow:
    start: str
    end: str

    def bounds(
        self,
    ) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
        start = parse_time(self.start)
        end = parse_time(self.end)

        if end < start:
            raise TemporalError(
                "time window ends before it starts"
            )

        return start, end

    @property
    def seconds(self) -> float:
        start, end = self.bounds()
        return (end - start).total_seconds()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PhysicalEvent:
    event_id: str
    at: str
    location: Point3 | None = None
    duration_seconds: float = 0.0
    metadata: Mapping[str, Any] = field(
        default_factory=dict
    )

    def timestamp(self) -> datetime:
        return parse_time(self.at)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TemporalConstraint:
    before: str
    after: str
    minimum_gap_seconds: float = 0.0
    maximum_gap_seconds: float | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Reachability:
    reachable: bool
    distance_meters: float
    available_seconds: float
    required_seconds: float | None
    required_velocity_mps: float | None
    velocity_limit_mps: float | None
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FeasibilityProjection:
    feasible: bool
    temporal: bool
    spatial: bool
    physical: bool
    reasons: tuple[str, ...]
    metrics: Mapping[str, Any]
    owner: str = OWNER
    authority_effect: str = "none"

    def projection(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["schema"] = SCHEMA
        payload["generated_at"] = utc_now()
        payload["digest"] = digest(payload)
        return payload


def distance(
    first: Point3,
    second: Point3,
    *,
    output_unit: str = "m",
) -> float:
    ax, ay, az = first.meters()
    bx, by, bz = second.meters()

    meters = math.sqrt(
        ((bx - ax) ** 2)
        + ((by - ay) ** 2)
        + ((bz - az) ** 2)
    )

    return convert(
        meters,
        from_unit="m",
        to_unit=output_unit,
        dimension="distance",
    )


def duration_between(
    start: Any,
    end: Any,
    *,
    output_unit: str = "s",
) -> float:
    start_dt = parse_time(start)
    end_dt = parse_time(end)

    seconds = (
        end_dt - start_dt
    ).total_seconds()

    return convert(
        seconds,
        from_unit="s",
        to_unit=output_unit,
        dimension="duration",
    )


def required_velocity(
    first: Point3,
    second: Point3,
    *,
    start: Any,
    end: Any,
    output_unit: str = "m/s",
) -> float:
    seconds = duration_between(
        start,
        end,
        output_unit="s",
    )

    meters = distance(
        first,
        second,
        output_unit="m",
    )

    if seconds < 0:
        raise TemporalError(
            "arrival precedes departure"
        )

    if abs(seconds) <= EPSILON:
        if meters <= EPSILON:
            return 0.0

        return math.inf

    meters_per_second = meters / seconds

    return convert(
        meters_per_second,
        from_unit="m/s",
        to_unit=output_unit,
        dimension="velocity",
    )


def travel_time(
    first: Point3,
    second: Point3,
    *,
    velocity: Any,
    velocity_unit: str = "m/s",
    output_unit: str = "s",
) -> float:
    speed_mps = convert(
        _nonnegative(velocity, "velocity"),
        from_unit=velocity_unit,
        to_unit="m/s",
        dimension="velocity",
    )

    meters = distance(
        first,
        second,
        output_unit="m",
    )

    if speed_mps <= EPSILON:
        if meters <= EPSILON:
            seconds = 0.0
        else:
            return math.inf
    else:
        seconds = meters / speed_mps

    return convert(
        seconds,
        from_unit="s",
        to_unit=output_unit,
        dimension="duration",
    )


def reachable(
    first: Point3,
    second: Point3,
    *,
    departure: Any,
    arrival_deadline: Any,
    velocity_limit: Any | None = None,
    velocity_unit: str = "m/s",
) -> Reachability:
    available = duration_between(
        departure,
        arrival_deadline,
        output_unit="s",
    )

    meters = distance(
        first,
        second,
        output_unit="m",
    )

    if available < 0:
        return Reachability(
            reachable=False,
            distance_meters=meters,
            available_seconds=available,
            required_seconds=None,
            required_velocity_mps=None,
            velocity_limit_mps=None,
            reason="arrival deadline precedes departure",
        )

    if meters <= EPSILON:
        return Reachability(
            reachable=True,
            distance_meters=0.0,
            available_seconds=available,
            required_seconds=0.0,
            required_velocity_mps=0.0,
            velocity_limit_mps=(
                None
                if velocity_limit is None
                else convert(
                    velocity_limit,
                    from_unit=velocity_unit,
                    to_unit="m/s",
                    dimension="velocity",
                )
            ),
            reason="origin and destination coincide",
        )

    if available <= EPSILON:
        return Reachability(
            reachable=False,
            distance_meters=meters,
            available_seconds=available,
            required_seconds=None,
            required_velocity_mps=math.inf,
            velocity_limit_mps=None,
            reason="no positive travel time available",
        )

    required_mps = meters / available

    if velocity_limit is None:
        return Reachability(
            reachable=True,
            distance_meters=meters,
            available_seconds=available,
            required_seconds=None,
            required_velocity_mps=required_mps,
            velocity_limit_mps=None,
            reason=(
                "geometrically reachable; "
                "no velocity limit supplied"
            ),
        )

    limit_mps = convert(
        _nonnegative(
            velocity_limit,
            "velocity_limit",
        ),
        from_unit=velocity_unit,
        to_unit="m/s",
        dimension="velocity",
    )

    required_seconds = (
        math.inf
        if limit_mps <= EPSILON
        else meters / limit_mps
    )

    possible = (
        required_mps
        <= limit_mps + EPSILON
    )

    return Reachability(
        reachable=possible,
        distance_meters=meters,
        available_seconds=available,
        required_seconds=required_seconds,
        required_velocity_mps=required_mps,
        velocity_limit_mps=limit_mps,
        reason=(
            "reachable within velocity limit"
            if possible
            else "velocity limit makes arrival infeasible"
        ),
    )


def windows_overlap(
    first: TimeWindow,
    second: TimeWindow,
    *,
    touching_counts: bool = True,
) -> bool:
    a_start, a_end = first.bounds()
    b_start, b_end = second.bounds()

    if touching_counts:
        return (
            a_start <= b_end
            and b_start <= a_end
        )

    return (
        a_start < b_end
        and b_start < a_end
    )


def intersection(
    first: TimeWindow,
    second: TimeWindow,
) -> TimeWindow | None:
    a_start, a_end = first.bounds()
    b_start, b_end = second.bounds()

    start = max(a_start, b_start)
    end = min(a_end, b_end)

    if end < start:
        return None

    return TimeWindow(
        start=start.isoformat(),
        end=end.isoformat(),
    )


def event_order(
    events: Iterable[PhysicalEvent],
) -> tuple[PhysicalEvent, ...]:
    return tuple(
        sorted(
            events,
            key=lambda event: (
                event.timestamp(),
                event.event_id,
            ),
        )
    )


def validate_temporal_constraints(
    events: Sequence[PhysicalEvent],
    constraints: Sequence[
        TemporalConstraint
    ],
) -> tuple[bool, tuple[str, ...]]:
    by_id = {
        event.event_id: event
        for event in events
    }

    failures: list[str] = []

    for constraint in constraints:
        before = by_id.get(
            constraint.before
        )
        after = by_id.get(
            constraint.after
        )

        if before is None:
            failures.append(
                f"missing event: {constraint.before}"
            )
            continue

        if after is None:
            failures.append(
                f"missing event: {constraint.after}"
            )
            continue

        minimum = _nonnegative(
            constraint.minimum_gap_seconds,
            "minimum_gap_seconds",
        )

        maximum = (
            None
            if constraint.maximum_gap_seconds
            is None
            else _nonnegative(
                constraint.maximum_gap_seconds,
                "maximum_gap_seconds",
            )
        )

        if (
            maximum is not None
            and maximum < minimum
        ):
            failures.append(
                f"{constraint.before}->{constraint.after}: "
                "maximum gap is below minimum gap"
            )
            continue

        before_end = (
            before.timestamp()
            + timedelta(
                seconds=_nonnegative(
                    before.duration_seconds,
                    "duration_seconds",
                )
            )
        )

        gap = (
            after.timestamp()
            - before_end
        ).total_seconds()

        if gap + EPSILON < minimum:
            failures.append(
                f"{constraint.before}->{constraint.after}: "
                f"gap {gap} below minimum {minimum}"
            )

        if (
            maximum is not None
            and gap - EPSILON > maximum
        ):
            failures.append(
                f"{constraint.before}->{constraint.after}: "
                f"gap {gap} above maximum {maximum}"
            )

    return (
        not failures,
        tuple(failures),
    )


def assess_transition(
    *,
    origin: Point3,
    destination: Point3,
    departure: Any,
    arrival_deadline: Any,
    velocity_limit: Any | None = None,
    velocity_unit: str = "m/s",
    constraints_satisfied: bool = True,
    additional_reasons: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> FeasibilityProjection:
    reach = reachable(
        origin,
        destination,
        departure=departure,
        arrival_deadline=arrival_deadline,
        velocity_limit=velocity_limit,
        velocity_unit=velocity_unit,
    )

    temporal = (
        reach.available_seconds >= 0
    )

    spatial = math.isfinite(
        reach.distance_meters
    )

    physical = reach.reachable

    reasons = list(additional_reasons)

    if not temporal:
        reasons.append(
            "temporal ordering is infeasible"
        )

    if not spatial:
        reasons.append(
            "spatial distance is invalid"
        )

    if not physical:
        reasons.append(
            reach.reason
        )

    if not constraints_satisfied:
        reasons.append(
            "external physical constraints are unsatisfied"
        )

    feasible = (
        temporal
        and spatial
        and physical
        and constraints_satisfied
    )

    if feasible and not reasons:
        reasons.append(
            "transition satisfies supplied spacetime constraints"
        )

    return FeasibilityProjection(
        feasible=feasible,
        temporal=temporal,
        spatial=spatial,
        physical=physical,
        reasons=tuple(reasons),
        metrics={
            "distance_meters": (
                reach.distance_meters
            ),
            "available_seconds": (
                reach.available_seconds
            ),
            "required_seconds": (
                reach.required_seconds
            ),
            "required_velocity_mps": (
                reach.required_velocity_mps
            ),
            "velocity_limit_mps": (
                reach.velocity_limit_mps
            ),
        },
    )


def capabilities() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "schema": SCHEMA,

        "primitive": "spacetime",

    }

# ENHANCEMENT 18 --- SOURCE INTEGRITY DISPLAY

**Authority status:** migration-canon candidate. This document records
the current target architecture and verified historical evidence. It
must be admitted through Savant's live authority/evolution process
before becoming runtime authority. Historical source statements are
preserved rather than silently rewritten.

## Objective

Expose integrity/provenance metadata without presenting it as a
substantive conclusion.

## Why it matters

This enhancement strengthens Nexus/Savant functionality, reliability,
inspectability, performance, accessibility or evolution rather than
merely changing appearance.

## Integration constraints

-   reuse existing Savant capability before adding a duplicate;
-   preserve ontology and authority boundaries;
-   preserve evidence/provenance;
-   maintain deterministic/replayable behavior where applicable;
-   profile mobile/runtime cost;
-   keep projection libraries replaceable;
-   emit diagnostics/receipts where appropriate.

## Dependency policy

Prefer native platform/runtime primitives when sufficient. Any
third-party dependency requires benefit, bundle/runtime cost,
maintenance, license, security, accessibility, mobile-performance and
exit-strategy review.

## Acceptance

The enhancement must have a measurable functional test and must not
regress unrelated Savant behavior.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json

from pathlib import Path
from types import ModuleType
from typing import Any, Mapping


owner = "coda"
component = "governance-surface"
governance_owner = "living-governance"
authority_effect = "none"
schema = "savant.coda.governance-surface.v1"

coda_root = (
    Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
)

runtime_root = (
    coda_root
    / "runtime"
)

capability_path = (
    coda_root
    / "interface/capabilities/"
    "governance_receipts.json"
)

contract_path = (
    coda_root
    / "interface/contracts/"
    "governance_receipts.json"
)


class coda_governance_surface_error(
    RuntimeError
):
    pass


def load_json(
    path: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        value = json.loads(
            path.read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )

    except OSError as exc:
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "cannot read "
                + str(path)
                + ": "
                + str(exc)
            )
        ) from exc

    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "invalid json in "
                + str(path)
                + ": "
                + str(exc)
            )
        ) from exc

    if not isinstance(
        value,
        dict,
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "expected json object: "
                + str(path)
            )
        )

    return value


def load_module(
    name: str,
    path: Path,
) -> ModuleType:
    if not path.is_file():
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "runtime module missing: "
                + str(path)
            )
        )

    spec = (
        importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
            name,
            path,
        )
    )

    if (
        spec is None
        or spec.loader is None
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "cannot load runtime module: "
                + str(path)
            )
        )

    module = (
        importlib.util.module_from_spec(
            spec
        )
    )

    spec.loader.exec_module(
        module
    )

    return module


def descriptors() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "capabilities":
            load_json(
                capability_path
            ),

        "contracts":
            load_json(
                contract_path
            ),
    }


def runtime_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
    governed = load_module(
        (
            "savant_coda_"
            "palaver_governed_bridge"
        ),
        runtime_root
        / "palaver_governed_bridge.py",
    )

    receipts = load_module(
        (
            "savant_coda_"
            "governance_receipts"
        ),
        runtime_root
        / "governance_receipts.py",
    )

    bridge_status_fn = getattr(
        governed,
        "bridge_status",
        None,
    )

    receipt_status_fn = getattr(
        receipts,
        "status",
        None,
    )

    if not callable(
        bridge_status_fn
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "governed bridge does not "
                "expose bridge_status()"
            )
        )

    if not callable(
        receipt_status_fn
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "governance receipt runtime "
                "does not expose status()"
            )
        )

    bridge = bridge_status_fn()
    receipt = receipt_status_fn()

    if not isinstance(
        bridge,
        Mapping,
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "bridge status did not "
                "return an object"
            )
        )

    if not isinstance(
        receipt,
        Mapping,
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "receipt status did not "
                "return an object"
            )
        )

    return {
        "bridge":
            dict(
                bridge
            ),

        "receipts":
            dict(
                receipt
            ),
    }


def status() -> dict[str, Any]:
    declared = descriptors()
    runtime = runtime_status()

    capability = declared[
        "capabilities"
    ]

    contract = declared[
        "contracts"
    ]

    bridge = runtime[
        "bridge"
    ]

    receipts = runtime[
        "receipts"
    ]

    ready = bool(
        capability.get(
            "owner"
        )
        == "coda"
        and contract.get(
            "owner"
        )
        == "coda"
        and bridge.get(
            "ready"
        )
        is True
        and receipts.get(
            "ready"
        )
        is True
        and bridge.get(
            "mutation_owner"
        )
        == "coda"
        and receipts.get(
            "mutation_owner"
        )
        == "coda"
        and bridge.get(
            "authority_transfer"
        )
        is False
        and receipts.get(
            "authority_transfer"
        )
        is False
    )

    return {
        "schema":
            schema,

        "kind":
            "status",

        "owner":
            owner,

        "component":
            component,

        "governance_owner":
            governance_owner,

        "authority_effect":
            authority_effect,

        "capability_descriptor":
            capability.get(
                "id"
            ),

        "contract_descriptor":
            contract.get(
                "id"
            ),

        "live_bridge_schema":
            bridge.get(
                "live_bridge_schema"
            ),

        "live_bridge_ready":
            bridge.get(
                "live_bridge_ready"
            ),

        (
            "governed_bridge_"
            "ready"
        ):
            bridge.get(
                "ready"
            ),

        (
            "durable_receipt_"
            "linkage_ready"
        ):
            receipts.get(
                "ready"
            ),

        "mutation_owner":
            "coda",

        "governance_owner":
            governance_owner,

        "live_bridge_replaced":
            False,

        "second_authority_store_created":
            False,

        "authority_transfer":
            False,

        "ready":
            ready,
    }


def selftest() -> dict[str, Any]:
    declared = descriptors()

    capability = declared[
        "capabilities"
    ]

    contract = declared[
        "contracts"
    ]

    capability_ids = {
        str(
            value.get(
                "id",
                "",
            )
        )
        for value
        in capability.get(
            "capabilities",
            [],
        )
        if isinstance(
            value,
            Mapping,
        )
    }

    required_capabilities = {
        (
            "governance_evaluation_"
            "receipt_linkage"
        ),
        (
            "palaver_governed_"
            "mutation_bridge"
        ),
        "governance_receipt_surface",
    }

    if not required_capabilities.issubset(
        capability_ids
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "governance capability "
                "descriptor is incomplete"
            )
        )

    contract_ids = {
        str(
            value.get(
                "id",
                "",
            )
        )
        for value
        in contract.get(
            "contracts",
            [],
        )
        if isinstance(
            value,
            Mapping,
        )
    }

    required_contracts = {
        (
            "build_governance_"
            "evaluation_link"
        ),
        (
            "persist_governance_"
            "evaluation_link"
        ),
        (
            "palaver_governed_"
            "replace_file"
        ),
    }

    if not required_contracts.issubset(
        contract_ids
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "governance contract "
                "descriptor is incomplete"
            )
        )

    governed = load_module(
        (
            "savant_coda_"
            "palaver_governed_bridge_test"
        ),
        runtime_root
        / "palaver_governed_bridge.py",
    )

    receipts = load_module(
        (
            "savant_coda_"
            "governance_receipts_test"
        ),
        runtime_root
        / "governance_receipts.py",
    )

    bridge_test = getattr(
        governed,
        "selftest",
        None,
    )

    receipt_test = getattr(
        receipts,
        "selftest",
        None,
    )

    if not callable(
        bridge_test
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "governed bridge selftest "
                "is unavailable"
            )
        )

    if not callable(
        receipt_test
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "receipt-link selftest "
                "is unavailable"
            )
        )

    bridge_result = bridge_test()
    receipt_result = receipt_test()

    if (
        not isinstance(
            bridge_result,
            Mapping,
        )
        or bridge_result.get(
            "ok"
        )
        is not True
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "governed bridge "
                "selftest failed"
            )
        )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            receipt_result,
            Mapping,
        )
        or receipt_result.get(
            "ok"
        )
        is not True
    ):
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "governance receipt "
                "selftest failed"
            )
        )

    current = status()

    if current.get(
        "ready"
    ) is not True:
        raise coda_governance_surface_error(
            (
                "governance surface "
                "is not ready"
            )
        )

    return {
        "schema":
            schema,

        "kind":
            "selftest",

        "owner":
            owner,

        "component":
            component,

        "governance_owner":
            governance_owner,

        "authority_effect":
            authority_effect,

        "ok":
            True,

        "capabilities_discoverable":
            True,

        "contracts_discoverable":
            True,

        "live_v2_bridge_preserved":
            True,

        "governed_bridge_available":
            True,

        (
            "durable_governance_"
            "receipt_link_available"
        ):
            True,

        "mutation_owner":
            "coda",

        "governance_owner":
            "living-governance",

        "live_bridge_replaced":
            False,

        "second_authority_store_created":
            False,

        "source_state_mutated":
            False,

        "authority_transfer":
            False,
    }

    "descriptors",
    "runtime_status",
    "selftest",
    "status",
]

# CONSTITUTIONAL OBJECT MODEL
Version: 1.2.0
Status: Canonical

---

# Purpose

The Constitutional Object Model defines every authoritative object that may exist within Savant.

All constitutional data shall be represented using these object types.

New object types require constitutional governance.

---

# Principles

The object model shall be:

- normalized
- deterministic
- replayable
- composable
- extensible
- graph-addressable
- authority-aware
- versioned
- observable

---

# Architectural edifice

Only the atomic character level is directly substantiated.

Everything above it is composed.

Canonical edifice:

1. Atomic Character
2. Line Instance
3. Snippet Instance
4. Component Instance
5. Behavior Instance
6. Script Instance
7. Subsystem Instance
8. Runtime Instance
9. System Composition

Every higher layer composes lower layers.

Nothing duplicates lower-level authority.

---

# Constitutional Objects

Authoritative objects include:

- Record
- Decision
- Evidence
- Receipt
- Event
- Attestation
- Validator
- Policy
- Schema
- Manifest
- Runtime Metadata
- Typed Segue

Derived objects include:

- Projection
- Report
- Dashboard
- Queue
- Index
- Cache
- Observatory
- Execution Plan
- Migration Packet

Derived objects possess no authority.

---

# Universal Fields

Every authoritative object exposes:

- identifier
- object class
- semantic identity
- authority source
- creation event
- lineage
- provenance
- version
- semantic digest

---

# Typed Segues

Relationships exist only through typed segues.

Examples:

- authority
- dependency
- composition
- attachment
- projection
- validation
- ownership
- lineage
- provenance
- succession
- compatibility
- contradiction
- observation
- evidence
- migration
- execution
- recovery
- supersession

Reverse relationships are projected.

---

# Identity

Identity never changes.

Implementations may evolve.

Authority may supersede.

Identity remains stable.

---

# Normalization

Every authoritative fact exists exactly once.

Everything reusable is referenced.

Everything derived is regenerated.

---

# Constitutional Guarantee

The object model provides the permanent constitutional vocabulary from which every Savant implementation is composed.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="/root/savant-runtime"
ENV_FILE="/root/.env"
BUCKET="savant-ai-cluster"
PREFIX="source-dumps"
STAMP="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
OUT="/root/savant-runtime/current_runtime_source_dump_${STAMP}.txt"

set -a
source "$ENV_FILE"
set +a

cd "$ROOT"

python3 - <<'PY' "$ROOT" "$OUT"
import os, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

root = Path(__import__("sys").argv[1])
out = Path(__import__("sys").argv[2])

SKIP_DIRS = {
    ".git","node_modules","__pycache__",".pytest_cache",".mypy_cache",
    ".venv","venv","env","dist","build",".cache","coverage"
}
SKIP_SUFFIX = {
    ".log",".png",".jpg",".jpeg",".gif",".webp",".mp4",".mov",".zip",".gz",".tar",".tgz",
    ".sqlite",".db",".pyc",".woff",".woff2",".ttf"
}
KEEP_SUFFIX = {
    ".py",".js",".jsx",".ts",".tsx",".html",".css",".json",".md",".txt",".sh",".yml",".yaml",".toml"
}

def skip(p):
    parts=set(p.relative_to(root).parts)
    if parts & SKIP_DIRS:
        return True
    if p.suffix.lower() in SKIP_SUFFIX:
        return True
    if p.suffix.lower() not in KEEP_SUFFIX:
        return True
    if p.stat().st_size > 750_000:
        return True
    return False

def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    h.update(p.read_bytes())
    return h.hexdigest()

files=[]
for p in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
    if p.is_file() and not skip(p):
        files.append(p)

with out.open("w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as w:
    w.write("CURRENT SAVANT RUNTIME SOURCE DUMP\n")
    w.write("="*100+"\n")
    w.write(f"Created UTC: {datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}\n")
    w.write(f"Root: {root}\n")
    w.write(f"Files included: {len(files)}\n\n")

    w.write("FILE TREE\n")
    w.write("="*100+"\n")
    for p in files:
        w.write(str(p.relative_to(root))+"\n")

    for p in files:
        rel = p.relative_to(root)
        body = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        w.write("\n"+"="*100+"\n")
        w.write(f"FILE: {rel}\n")
        w.write(f"BYTES: {p.stat().st_size}\n")
        w.write(f"SHA256: {sha(p)}\n")
        w.write("="*100+"\n\n")
        w.write(body)
        if not body.endswith("\n"):
            w.write("\n")

print(out)
PY

aws s3 cp "$OUT" "s3://${BUCKET}/${PREFIX}/$(basename "$OUT")"

echo "[OK] uploaded:"
echo "s3://${BUCKET}/${PREFIX}/$(basename "$OUT")"

import {
  useWorkspaceStore
} from "./state/workspace-store"


type Cleanup = () => void


const modules = [
  {
    id: "chat",
    label: "chat"
  },
  {
    id: "terminal",
    label: "terminal"
  },
  {
    id: "memory",
    label: "memory"
  },
  {
    id: "uploads",
    label: "uploads"
  },
  {
    id: "search",
    label: "search"
  },
  {
    id: "source",
    label: "files"
  }
] as const


export function installMobileControlDock(): Cleanup {
  const existing =
    document.getElementById(
      "palaver-mobile-control-dock"
    )

  if (existing) {
    existing.remove()
  }


  const dock =
    document.createElement(
      "nav"
    )

  dock.id =
    "palaver-mobile-control-dock"

  dock.setAttribute(
    "aria-label",
    "palaver mobile navigation"
  )


  Object.assign(
    dock.style,
    {
      position: "fixed",
      left: "8px",
      right: "8px",
      bottom: "30px",
      zIndex: "2147483647",
      display: "flex",
      gap: "5px",
      padding: "7px",
      overflowX: "auto",
      background:
        "rgba(3,4,7,.96)",
      border:
        "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16)",
      borderRadius:
        "14px",
      boxShadow:
        "0 12px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.6)",
      pointerEvents:
        "auto",
      touchAction:
        "manipulation",
      WebkitOverflowScrolling:
        "touch"
    }
  )


  const activate = (
    id: typeof modules[number]["id"]
  ) => {
    useWorkspaceStore
      .getState()
      .setActive(
        id
      )
  }


  for (const module of modules) {
    const button =
      document.createElement(
        "button"
      )

    button.type =
      "button"

    button.textContent =
      module.label

    button.dataset.palaverModule =
      module.id


    Object.assign(
      button.style,
      {
        flex: "0 0 auto",
        minWidth: "72px",
        minHeight: "44px",
        padding: "0 10px",
        border:
          "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)",
        borderRadius:
          "10px",
        background:
          "rgba(255,255,255,.05)",
        color:
          "#ece8dc",
        font:
          "600 11px system-ui, sans-serif",
        letterSpacing:
          ".06em",
        textTransform:
          "uppercase",
        pointerEvents:
          "auto",
        touchAction:
          "manipulation"
      }
    )


    let activatedAt = 0


    const run = (
      event: Event
    ) => {
      event.stopPropagation()

      const now =
        performance.now()

      if (
        now - activatedAt
        < 350
      ) {
        return
      }

      activatedAt =
        now

      activate(
        module.id
      )
    }


    button.addEventListener(
      "touchstart",
      run,
      {
        passive: true
      }
    )

    button.addEventListener(
      "pointerdown",
      run
    )

    button.addEventListener(
      "click",
      run
    )


    dock.appendChild(
      button
    )
  }


  document.body.appendChild(
    dock
  )


  return () => {
    dock.remove()
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import ssl
import subprocess
import sys
import traceback
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, UTC
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RUNTIME = ROOT / "runtime"
PORT = int(os.getenv("PALAVER_WEB_PORT", "8787"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(RUNTIME))


def load_env():
    env = ROOT / ".env"
    if not env.exists():
        return
    for line in env.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        os.environ.setdefault(k.strip(), v.strip().strip('"').strip("'"))


load_env()

try:
    from core import diagnostics, rebuild_all, memory_block_for_prompt
except Exception:
    diagnostics = None
    rebuild_all = None
    memory_block_for_prompt = None

function renderTree(node){
 const icon=node.type==="directory"?"▸":"•";
 const cls=node.type==="directory"?"treeDir":"treeFile";
 const path=node.path||"";
 const safe=path.replaceAll("'","\\'");
 let click=node.type==="file"
   ? `openFile('${safe}')`
   : `toggleDir('${safe}')`;
 let html=`<div class="treeItem ${cls}" onclick="${click}">${icon} ${esc(node.name)}</div>`;
 if(node.type==="directory"){
   html+=`<div data-children="${esc(path)}" style="padding-left:12px">`;
   if(node.children){
     for(const child of node.children)html+=renderTree(child);
   }
   html+=`</div>`;
 }
 return html;
}

def now():
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def send_json(h, payload, code=200):
    data = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    h.send_response(code)
    h.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
    h.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
    h.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
    h.end_headers()
    h.wfile.write(data)


def send_html(h, html, code=200):
    data = html.encode()
    h.send_response(code)
    h.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
    h.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
    h.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
    h.end_headers()
    h.wfile.write(data)


def body_json(h):
    n = int(h.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
    raw = h.rfile.read(n).decode() if n else "{}"
    try:
        return json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        return {}


def run_cmd(args, input_text=None):
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=str(ROOT), input=input_text, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    return {"ok": p.returncode == 0, "out": (p.stdout or "") + (("\n[stderr]\n" + p.stderr) if p.stderr else ""), "code": p.returncode}


def health():
    return {
        "root": str(ROOT),
        "api_key_present": bool(os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")),
        "model": os.getenv("SAVANT_MODEL", "gpt-5"),
        "core_available": bool(diagnostics),
        "file_tool": (ROOT / "file").exists(),
        "search_tool": (ROOT / "search").exists(),
        "retrieve_tool": (ROOT / "retrieve").exists(),
        "patch_tool": (ROOT / "patch").exists(),
        "graph_info": (ROOT / "graph_info").exists(),
    }


def safe_rel_path(path):
    path = (path or "").strip().lstrip("/")
    target = (ROOT / path).resolve()
    root = ROOT.resolve()
    if not (str(target).startswith(str(root) + "/") or target == root):
        raise RuntimeError("blocked outside root")
    rel = target.relative_to(root)
    if any(x in {".git", ".venv", "__pycache__", "node_modules"} for x in rel.parts):
        raise RuntimeError("blocked protected path")
    return target, str(rel)


def build_file_tree(base=None, max_depth=2, depth=0):
    target = ROOT if base is None else base

    node = {
        "name": "savant-runtime" if target == ROOT else target.name,
        "path": "" if target == ROOT else str(target.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "type": "directory" if target.is_dir() else "file",
    }

    if not target.is_dir():
        return node

    children = []

    try:
        items = sorted(
            target.iterdir(),
            key=lambda x: (
                x.is_file(),
                x.name.lower(),
            )
        )

        count = 0

        for child in items:
            if child.name in {
                ".git",
                ".venv",
                "__pycache__",
                "node_modules",
                ".pytest_cache",
                ".mypy_cache",
            }:
                continue

            if count >= 300:
                children.append({
                    "name": "[truncated]",
                    "path": node["path"],
                    "type": "file",
                })
                break

            if child.is_dir():
                children.append({
                    "name": child.name,
                    "path": str(child.relative_to(ROOT)),
                    "type": "directory",
                    "children": [],
                    "lazy": True,
                })
            else:
                try:
                    size = child.stat().st_size
                except Exception:
                    size = 0

                if size <= 750000:
                    children.append({
                        "name": child.name,
                        "path": str(child.relative_to(ROOT)),
                        "type": "file",
                        "size": size,
                    })

            count += 1

    except Exception:
        pass

    node["children"] = children
    return node


def list_directory_payload(path=""):
    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)

    if not target.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("missing path")

    if not target.is_dir():
        raise RuntimeError("not a directory")

    return build_file_tree(target, max_depth=1, depth=0)


def read_file_payload(path):
    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)
    if not target.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("missing file")
    if not target.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("not a file")
    text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    return {"path": rel, "size": len(text), "content": text[:160000]}


def graph_snapshot():
    p = ROOT / "vault" / "repository" / "dependencies" / "dependency_graph.json"
    if not p.exists():
        return {"nodes": [], "edges": []}
    return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def activity_timeline(limit=100):
    rows = []
    d = ROOT / "vault" / "web_chats"
    if d.exists():
        for f in sorted(d.glob("*.json"))[-limit:]:
            try:
                x = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                rows.append({"type": "chat", "timestamp": x.get("timestamp"), "summary": x.get("user", "")[:140]})
            except Exception:
                pass
    return rows




def save_file_payload(path, content):
    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)

    if any(x in {".git", ".venv", "__pycache__", "node_modules"} for x in target.relative_to(ROOT).parts):
        raise RuntimeError("blocked protected path")

    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

    return {
        "path": rel,
        "bytes": len(content.encode("utf-8")),
    }


def diff_payload(path, proposed):
    import difflib

    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)

    before = ""
    if target.exists() and target.is_file():
        before = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")

    diff = "".join(
        difflib.unified_diff(
            before.splitlines(True),
            proposed.splitlines(True),
            fromfile=f"before/{rel}",
            tofile=f"after/{rel}",
        )
    )

    return {
        "path": rel,
        "diff": diff,
    }


def workspace_state_load():
    state = ROOT / "vault" / "workspace" / "state.json"

    if not state.exists():
        return {
            "tabs": [],
            "active": None,
            "layout": {},
        }

    return json.loads(state.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def workspace_state_save(payload):
    state = ROOT / "vault" / "workspace" / "state.json"
    state.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    state.write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return {"ok": True}



def direct_command(message):
    low = message.lower().strip()

    if low in {"health", "status"}:
        return {"answer": json.dumps(health(), indent=2), "trace": "health"}

    if low == "diag":
        if diagnostics:
            return {"answer": json.dumps(diagnostics(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "trace": "diagnostics"}
        return {"answer": "diagnostics unavailable", "trace": "diagnostics unavailable"}

    if low == "files":
        r = run_cmd(["./file", "list", ".", "--limit", "1000"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "file list"}

    if low.startswith("file read "):
        target = message[len("file read "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./file", "read", target, "--start", "1", "--end", "900"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "file read"}

    if low.startswith("search "):
        q = message[len("search "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./search", "term", q, "--limit", "80"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "search"}

    if low.startswith("retrieve "):
        q = message[len("retrieve "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./retrieve", "term", q, "--limit", "30"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "retrieve"}

    if low == "graph":
        r = run_cmd(["./graph_info"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "graph"}

    if low == "patches":
        r = run_cmd(["./patch", "list"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "patch list"}

    if low == "repository report":
        r = run_cmd(["./repository", "report"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "repository report"}

    if low == "repository scan":
        r = run_cmd(["./repository", "scan"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "repository scan"}

    if low.startswith("patch show "):
        pid = message[len("patch show "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./patch", "show", pid])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "patch show"}

    if low.startswith("patch apply "):
        pid = message[len("patch apply "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./patch", "apply", pid])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "patch apply"}

    if low == "rebuild":
        if rebuild_all:
            return {"answer": json.dumps(rebuild_all(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "trace": "rebuild_all"}
        r = run_cmd(["./rebuild_search_index.sh"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "rebuild fallback"}

    return None


def call_openai(message, context=""):
    key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not key:
        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY missing")

    user = message if not context else "Context:\n" + context + "\n\nUser:\n" + message
    payload = {"model": os.getenv("SAVANT_MODEL", "gpt-5"), "input": [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]}
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"}, method="POST")

    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120, context=ssl.create_default_context()) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

    if data.get("output_text"):
        return data["output_text"]

    texts = []
    for item in data.get("output", []):
        for c in item.get("content", []):
            if c.get("text"):
                texts.append(c["text"])
    return "\n".join(texts).strip() or json.dumps(data, indent=2)


def persist(user, assistant, trace):
    d = ROOT / "vault" / "web_chats"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
    (d / f"{stamp}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"timestamp": now(), "user": user, "assistant": assistant, "trace": trace}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def chat(message):
    cmd = direct_command(message)
    if cmd:
        persist(message, cmd["answer"], cmd["trace"])
        return cmd

    trace = []
    context = ""

    if memory_block_for_prompt:
        try:
            context = memory_block_for_prompt(message, limit=8) or ""
            trace.append("memory attached" if context else "memory empty")
        except Exception as e:
            trace.append("memory error: " + str(e))

    try:
        answer = call_openai(message, context)
        trace.append("openai ok")
    except Exception as e:
        answer = "AI response failed:\n\n" + str(e) + "\n\nRun health. Commands still work."
        trace.append("openai failed")

    persist(message, answer, "\n".join(trace))
    return {"answer": answer, "trace": "\n".join(trace)}



def runtime_payload():
    repo_index = ROOT / "vault" / "repository" / "files" / "files.json"
    graph_index = ROOT / "vault" / "repository" / "dependencies" / "dependency_graph.json"

    return {
        "root": str(ROOT),
        "runtime_exists": (ROOT / "runtime").exists(),
        "vault_exists": (ROOT / "vault").exists(),
        "webui_ultra": (ROOT / "webui_ultra").exists(),
        "webui_nextgen": (ROOT / "webui-nextgen").exists(),
        "repository_index": repo_index.exists(),
        "repository_graph": graph_index.exists(),
        "sessions_dir": (ROOT / "sessions").exists(),
        "agents_dir": (ROOT / "vault" / "agents").exists(),
    }


def repository_files_payload(limit=2500):
    indexed = (
        ROOT /
        "vault" /
        "repository" /
        "files" /
        "files.json"
    )

    if indexed.exists():
        try:
            data = json.loads(
                indexed.read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8"
                )
            )

            return [
                x.get("path")
                for x in data.get("files", [])
                if x.get("path")
            ][:limit]

        except Exception:
            pass

    fallback_roots = [
        ROOT / "runtime",
        ROOT / "webui_ultra",
        ROOT / "webui-nextgen" / "src",
        ROOT / "docs",
    ]

    rows = []

    for base in fallback_roots:
        if not base.exists():
            continue

        for f in base.rglob("*"):
            if not f.is_file():
                continue

            rows.append(
                str(
                    f.relative_to(ROOT)
                )
            )

            if len(rows) >= limit:
                return rows

    return rows


def memory_files_payload(limit=500):
    roots = [
        ROOT / "vault" / "web_chats",
        ROOT / "vault" / "message_registry",
        ROOT / "vault" / "knowledge",
        ROOT / "sessions",
    ]

    rows = []

    for base in roots:
        if not base.exists():
            continue

        for f in base.glob("*.json"):
            rows.append(str(f.relative_to(ROOT)))
            if len(rows) >= limit:
                return rows

    return rows


def agent_jobs_payload():
    base = ROOT / "vault" / "agents" / "jobs"
    rows = []

    if not base.exists():
        return rows

    for f in sorted(base.glob("*.json")):
        try:
            rows.append(json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
        except Exception:
            rows.append({"path": str(f.relative_to(ROOT)), "error": "unreadable"})

    return rows



def patch_review_pending_payload():
    from runtime.patch_review_workflow import list_pending
    return list_pending()


def patch_review_create_payload(path, after):
    from runtime.patch_review_workflow import create
    import difflib

    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)

    before = ""
    if target.exists() and target.is_file():
        before = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")

    diff = "".join(
        difflib.unified_diff(
            before.splitlines(True),
            after.splitlines(True),
            fromfile="before/" + rel,
            tofile="after/" + rel,
        )
    )

    return create(rel, before, after, diff)


def patch_review_apply_payload(patch_id):
    from runtime.patch_review_workflow import apply_patch
    return apply_patch(patch_id)


def patch_review_reject_payload(patch_id):
    from runtime.patch_review_workflow import reject_patch
    return reject_patch(patch_id)




def read_text_payload(relative, limit=200000):
    target = (ROOT / relative).resolve()
    root = ROOT.resolve()

    try:
        target.relative_to(root)
    except Exception:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "path escapes root", "path": relative}

    if not target.exists():
        return {"ok": False, "error": "missing", "path": relative}

    try:
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except Exception as e:
        return {"ok": False, "error": str(e), "path": relative}

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "path": relative,
        "bytes": len(text.encode("utf-8")),
        "truncated": len(text) > limit,
        "text": text[:limit],
    }


def read_json_payload(relative, limit=200000):
    import json

    payload = read_text_payload(relative, limit=limit)

    if not payload.get("ok"):
        return payload

    try:
        payload["json"] = json.loads(payload["text"])
    except Exception as e:
        payload["json_error"] = str(e)

    return payload


def latest_matching_payload(glob_pattern, text=True):
    files = sorted(ROOT.glob(glob_pattern))

    if not files:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "no match", "glob": glob_pattern}

    rel = str(files[-1].relative_to(ROOT))

    if text:
        return read_text_payload(rel)

    return read_json_payload(rel)

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        try:
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            path = parsed.path

            # AUTHORITY_FORCE_ROUTES_START
            if path == "/api/authority/map":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/graph_address/graph_addresses.latest.tsv"))
                return

            if path == "/api/authority/relationships":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/relationships/system_relationships.latest.tsv"))
                return

            if path == "/api/authority/contracts":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/contracts/extension_contracts.md"))
                return

            if path == "/api/authority/palaver":
                send_json(self, latest_matching_payload("vault/authority/registries/palaver_exile_registry_*.json", text=False))
                return

            if path == "/api/authority/slots":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/authority/registries/instance_slots.tsv"))
                return

            if path == "/api/quarantine/ledger":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/quarantine/CLEANUP_LEDGER.md"))
                return

            if path == "/api/quarantine/restore-index":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/quarantine/RESTORE_INDEX.tsv"))
                return

            if path == "/api/dashboard/state":
                send_json(self, read_json_payload("vault/projections/dashboard/system_dashboard.json"))
                return
            # AUTHORITY_FORCE_ROUTES_END
            q = parse_qs(parsed.query)

            if path == "/":
                send_html(self, HTML)
                return

            if path == "/api/health":
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "health": health()})
                return

            if path == "/api/routes":
                send_json(self, {
                    "ok": True,
                    "routes": {
                        "get": [
                            "/",
                            "/api/health",
                            "/api/routes",
                            "/api/diagnostics/crash",
                            "/api/tree",
                            "/api/file",
                            "/api/graph",
                            "/api/timeline",
                            "/api/runtime",
                            "/api/repository/files",
                            "/api/memory/files",
                            "/api/memory/search",
                            "/api/agents/jobs"
                        ],
                        "post": [
                            "/api/chat",
                            "/api/file/save",
                            "/api/file/diff",
                            "/api/workspace/save",
                            "/api/patch/write",
                            "/api/patch/append",
                            "/api/patch-review/create",
                            "/api/patch-review/apply",
                            "/api/patch-review/reject"
                        ]
                    }
                })
                return

            if path == "/api/diagnostics/crash":
                base = ROOT / "vault" / "diagnostics" / "crashes"
                files = sorted(base.glob("*.txt")) if base.exists() else []
                if not files:
                    send_json(self, {"ok": True, "crash": None})
                    return
                latest = files[-1]
                send_json(self, {
                    "ok": True,
                    "crash": {
                        "file": str(latest.relative_to(ROOT)),
                        "content": latest.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")[:50000],
                    }
                })
                return

            if path == "/api/tree":
                target = q.get("path", [""])[0]
                base = ROOT / target if target else ROOT
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "tree": build_file_tree(base)})
                return

            if path == "/api/file":
                target = q.get("path", [""])[0]
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "file": read_file_payload(target)})
                return

            if path == "/api/graph":
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "graph": graph_snapshot()})
                return

            if path == "/api/timeline":
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "timeline": activity_timeline()})
                return

            if path == "/api/runtime":
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "runtime": runtime_payload()})
                return

            if path == "/api/repository/files":
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "files": repository_files_payload()})
                return

            if path == "/api/memory/files":
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "memory": memory_files_payload()})
                return

            if path == "/api/memory/search":
                term = q.get("q", [""])[0].lower().strip()
                rows = []

                roots = [
                    ROOT / "vault" / "web_chats",
                    ROOT / "vault" / "knowledge",
                    ROOT / "vault" / "message_registry",
                ]

                if term:
                    for base in roots:
                        if not base.exists():
                            continue

                        for f in base.glob("*.json"):
                            try:
                                text = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
                            except Exception:
                                continue

                            if term in text.lower():
                                rows.append({
                                    "path": str(f.relative_to(ROOT)),
                                    "preview": text[:500],
                                })

                                if len(rows) >= 50:
                                    break

                        if len(rows) >= 50:
                            break

                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "results": rows})
                return

            if path == "/api/agents/jobs":
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "jobs": agent_jobs_payload()})
                return


            elif path == "/api/authority/map":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/graph_address/graph_addresses.latest.tsv"))

            elif path == "/api/authority/relationships":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/relationships/system_relationships.latest.tsv"))

            elif path == "/api/authority/contracts":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/contracts/extension_contracts.md"))

            elif path == "/api/authority/palaver":
                send_json(self, latest_matching_payload("vault/authority/registries/palaver_exile_registry_*.json", text=False))

            elif path == "/api/authority/slots":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/authority/registries/instance_slots.tsv"))

            elif path == "/api/quarantine/ledger":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/quarantine/CLEANUP_LEDGER.md"))

            elif path == "/api/quarantine/restore-index":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/quarantine/RESTORE_INDEX.tsv"))

            elif path == "/api/dashboard/state":
                send_json(self, read_json_payload("vault/projections/dashboard/system_dashboard.json"))

            send_json(self, {"ok": False, "error": "not found"}, 404)

        except Exception as e:
            crash = ROOT / "vault" / "diagnostics" / "crashes"
            crash.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
            tb = traceback.format_exc()
            (crash / f"get_{stamp}.txt").write_text(tb, encoding="utf-8")
            send_json(self, {"ok": False, "error": str(e), "traceback": tb}, 500)

    def do_POST(self):
        try:
            path = urlparse(self.path).path
            data = body_json(self)

            if path == "/api/chat":
                message = data.get("message", "").strip()
                if not message:
                    send_json(self, {"ok": False, "answer": "", "trace": "empty"})
                    return
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, **chat(message)})
                return

            if path == "/api/file/save":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "file": save_file_payload(target, content)})
                return

            if path == "/api/file/diff":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "diff": diff_payload(target, content)})
                return

            if path == "/api/workspace/save":
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "result": workspace_state_save(data)})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch/write":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                intent = data.get("intent", "browser write proposal")
                r = run_cmd(["./patch", "write", target, "--stdin", "--intent", intent], input_text=content)
                send_json(self, {"ok": r["ok"], "output": r["out"]})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch/append":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                intent = data.get("intent", "browser append proposal")
                r = run_cmd(["./patch", "append", target, "--stdin", "--intent", intent], input_text=content)
                send_json(self, {"ok": r["ok"], "output": r["out"]})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch-review/create":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "patch": patch_review_create_payload(target, content)})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch-review/apply":
                patch_id = data.get("patch_id", "").strip()
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "patch": patch_review_apply_payload(patch_id)})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch-review/reject":
                patch_id = data.get("patch_id", "").strip()
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "patch": patch_review_reject_payload(patch_id)})
                return

            send_json(self, {"ok": False, "error": "not found"}, 404)

        except Exception as e:
            crash = ROOT / "vault" / "diagnostics" / "crashes"
            crash.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
            (crash / f"server_{stamp}.txt").write_text(traceback.format_exc(), encoding="utf-8")
            send_json(self, {"ok": False, "answer": "Server route crashed.", "trace": str(e)}, 500)


def main():
    print(f"Palaver Ultra running: http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}")
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", PORT), Handler).serve_forever()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
